 MATCH DETAILS 
 UDINESE 0-2 AC MILAN 
 UDINESE (3-4-2-1): Okoye; Abankwah, Palma, Kabasele; Vojvoda (63' Zaniolo), Karlström, Piotrowski (46' Miller), Kamara (63' Arizala); Ekkelenkamp, Chakvetadze; Davis. Subs.: Mrozek, Padelli; Bertola, Ebosse; Gómez, Lovrić, Zarraga; Jovanović, Vinciati. Coach: Runjaić. 
 AC MILAN (4-4-1-1): Maignan; Tomori (73' Musah), De Winter, Pavlović, Diawara; Hutchinson (73' Loftus-Cheek) (91' Comotto), Modrić, Jashari; Bartesaghi (85' A. Cisse); Pulisic; Ramos (91' Camarda). Subs.: Bouyer, Torriani; M. Cissé, Estupiñan, Perera, F. Terracciano, Vladimirov; Vos; Menon, Ossola. Coach: Amorim. 
 Referee: Marcenaro from Genova. 
 Goals : 6' Pulisic (M), 65' Hutchinson (M).
 Booked : 38' Ramos (M), 43' Karlström (U), 90' Modrić (M).
